preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= x <= 9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 0 and 9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(s) <= 3 and set(s).issubset({'-', '+', '*'}) and len(s) == len(set(s))
preconditions.description: The string s contains 1 to 3 distinct characters, all of which are valid operators ('-', '+', '*').

postconditions.expression: len(parts) == 2 * n - 1 and parts[0::2] == [str(x) for x in a] and all(op in s for op in parts[1::2])
postconditions.description: The output string, when split by operators, reconstructs the original sequence of numbers a, and every operator used is present in the allowed set s.

postconditions.expression: eval(output_text) == max(eval(''.join([str(a[i]) + op + str(a[i+1]) for i, op in enumerate(ops)])) for ops in product(s, repeat=n-1))
postconditions.description: The value of the constructed expression, evaluated with standard precedence (multiplication before addition/subtraction, left-to-right for same precedence), is the maximum possible value achievable using any valid sequence of n-1 operators from s.
